_comment: The MCP servers every agent on this machine gets, wherever it runs.
This file is the single source of truth: rouh/crew.py and one/asuser.py
both read it at launch, merge it with the checkout's own .mcp.json, and
hand the result to the agent with --mcp-config. To give every run another
server, add it here and change nothing else.
A checkout that defines the same name in its own .mcp.json keeps its own
entry: it is written over this file's in the merge (rouh/crew.py,
{repo} in a command, an argument or an environment value is the folder
this file is in, filled in by both readers, so a server that is a file of
this repository runs from the deployment's own copy of it, which no run
can change, wherever the run's own checkout is.
rouh is Rouh's own tools for a background job: notify_owner, which queues
an email to the person for Rouh to send (rouh/worker_mcp.py, rouh/outbox.py),
and every other tool of Rouh's a job may use, run by Rouh with its own logins
